item.title: [ 67] MMOs
item.description:
An MMO without an economy is missing the point. Why would you design a massively multiplayer world where players can't meaningfully trade, accumulate wealth, or provide goods and services to one another? Currency, direct trading, and an auction house aren't just convenience features. They're systems that create interdependence, specialization, and player-driven goals.

Without trading, you can't hire bodyguards, pay mercenaries, commission equipment, supply new guild members, fund allies, establish businesses, or build a network of suppliers. You're removing entire categories of gameplay and player interaction. A player-driven economy also gives people progression beyond combat. You can become wealthy, specialize in production, control supply chains, compete for resources, establish a reputation, or dominate a market. You don't need another gear tier or dungeon reset to have something worth pursuing.

Research on Aion, analyzing 94,870 players over 91 days, found strong correlations between direct trading networks and social interaction. Trading was correlated with private messaging (r = 0.72), party participation (r = 0.71), and friendships (r = 0.64). Even transactions through its centralized marketplace, the Agency, were positively correlated with messaging, parties, and friendships. Economic activity wasn't separate from the social experience. It was intertwined with it. That's what I think the genre is missing: worlds where players have reasons to depend on one another beyond grouping up to kill something.

A themepark gives you activities to complete. A functioning economy gives you a world to participate in.

item.title: [113] Trump Justice Dept breaks with tradition to intervene in midterms
item.description:
https://www.reuters.com/legal/government/trump-justice-dept-breaks-with-tradition-intervene-midterms-2026-11-02/

WASHINGTON, Nov 2 (Reuters) - President Donald Trump’s Justice Department has shown a willingness to intervene directly in Tuesday's midterm elections, breaking with decades of practice meant to avoid the appearance that its law enforcement powers are being used to benefit a political party or candidate.

In California, the Justice Department sought to set aside mail-in ballots from about 20,000 voters it alleges are likely non-US citizens ineligible to vote.

The department has also demanded records in a related criminal probe. California has said it has implemented measures to prevent voting by noncitizens and argued the Justice Department does not have the authority to block votes.

In Alaska, the department has intensified a criminal investigation into whether a Senate candidate with the same name as Republican incumbent Dan Sullivan entered the race to confuse voters. It also sought to block certification if Sullivan narrowly loses, but a federal judge dismissed that lawsuit on Sunday.

Courts have now rejected the department's lawsuits against both states, but the cases underscore the DOJ's willingness to intervene in election disputes before votes are counted and results certified. The department has appealed the Alaska decision.

Critics say the department could accelerate any attempt by Trump to sow doubt about the midterms, which will determine control of Congress and the winners of dozens of governors' races.

“It appears that the administration wants the department to have an impact that was previously prohibited,” said Mark Blumberg, who previously led the DOJ’s election response to civil rights threats and has since founded the Rule of Law Project.

item.title: [ 30] So, the 30th Anniversary three-volume Artbook is gonna show the original Ken Su
item.description:
So, the 30th Anniversary three-volume Artbook is gonna show the original Ken Sugimori concept art for the Johto Gym Leaders for the first time.
Although not in Teraleak, the existence of such art was obvious since ever, as it was the base for:
-The Stadium portraits
-The anime settei (seen in Teraleak, aside from Falkner)
-The (rarely-seen) colored anime Johto GL stock art,
which all show the Leaders in more-or-less consistent poses.

So far, they teased four of them.
I made this ugly but informative spreadsheet of all known iterations, which should be a hint of how the remaining four look like.

I've no idea why Falkner's anime settei is missing from the Teraleak. But I am sure that somebody (possibly Pokescans) once scanned a Japanese-only book full of settei for the early Johto episodes (I remember it having the settei for the spider creature from Gligarman episode, among others), which probably included Falkner's settei, but I wasn't able to re-find it. I've looked through Pokescans's Tumblr entire archive and found nothing (found only scans from an analogous book but for Kanto), so I'm not even quite sure if it was her (I remember those scans bearing the same "meh" picture quality like most of her pics) but many of her posts were DMCA'd, so anything's possible. Does anyone still have this? I'm mad at myself for not saving it back in the day.

Anyway, do you expect much never-before-seen stuff in the new Artbooks? Or is it going to be a letdown? Do you have any hopes about seeing a specific art or character?

Post your expectations, hopes and fears about the books and discuss obscure or unconfirmed official game art here.

item.title: [ 46] Trump lawsuit against Wall Street Journal over Epstein birthday letter dismissed with prejudice
item.description:
https://www.cbsnews.com/news/trump-lawsuit-wall-street-journal-epstein-birthday-letter-dismissed/

A multimillion-dollar defamation lawsuit by President Trump against The Wall Street Journal over a story reporting his ties to a birthday book for Jeffrey Epstein has been thrown out.

In a 20-page ruling, U.S. District Judge Darrin Gayles in Miami dismissed the suit with prejudice on Saturday, ruling that Mr. Trump did not prove the defendants made defamatory statements with actual malice.

He said the lawsuit was "grasping at straws" as it attempted to "manufacture" flaws in the WSJ's investigative reporting.

Actual malice requires that plaintiffs prove that statements made about a public figure were published with the knowledge that they were false, or with disregard for whether they are true or not.

When a case is thrown out "with prejudice," it cannot be refiled again, and the dismissal is permanent and incontrovertible.

"President Trump will continue to press forward in his powerhouse lawsuit against the Wall Street Journal and all of the other defendants," a spokesperson for Mr. Trump's legal team told CBS News in a statement. "The President will continue to hold those who mislead the American People with Fake News and smears accountable for their actions."

A source familiar with Mr. Trump's legal strategy said that the decision will likely be appealed.

The lawsuit was over a story the WSJ published last year describing a sexually suggestive letter that the paper said bore Mr. Trump's name and was included in a 2003 album compiled for Epstein's 50th birthday.

item.title: [ 83] Trump team suddenly very uninterested in MN fraud
item.description:
https://www.kare11.com/article/news/investigations/waste-of-our-time-trump-administration-officials-respond-to-kare-11-investigation-into-prison-sale/89-06700a38-fe80-408d-88e8-0d1f5b9fc4cf

'Waste of our time' | Trump administration officials respond to KARE 11 investigation into prison sale

Members of the Trump administration, visiting St. Cloud to discuss fraud on Friday, dismissed a question about federal overpayment for a Minnesota private prison.
ST. CLOUD, Minn. — U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent dismissed a question about a recent KARE 11 investigation into the federal government's overpayment for a private prison in Appleton, Minnesota, in the administration's first public response to the report.

KARE 11's reporting showed the Department of Homeland Security paid $495 million to purchase CoreCivic's abandoned private prison to use as an ICE facility, when that same facility was offered to the state one year earlier for $75 million.

The price difference for the prison sale, $420 million, is more than taxpayers are estimated to have lost in Minnesota’s much-publicized Feeding Our Future fraud scandal.

Bessent was joined by other members of the Trump administration at a press event in St. Cloud Friday to discuss the administration's "War on Fraud."

When the event opened to reporter questions, KARE 11's Lou Raguse asked Bessent, "If the administration has declared war on waste and fraud, could you explain the $420 million overpayment for a prison in Appleton, Minnesota, when the company offered it to the state of Minnesota for $75 million?"

"I don't know anything about that," Bessent responded. "What we are here to do is to prosecute criminal fraud, and any question like that, that deflects away from it, I think is a waste of our time, thanks."

item.title: [ 89] /out/ings with a Pipe Autumn Edition
item.description:
Last thread >>2868475

This is a thread for enjoying a pipe while doing outdoor activities. If you ask why this belongs on /out/, you've never spent
an evening by the campfire with a pipe silently enjoying the nature around you, and you're missing out.

>how to get started
Purchase a corn cob pipe (or a cheap briar pipe) and a pouch of Half and Half or Captain Black tobacco from a smoke shop
or online. You will need a lighter or match, and something to tamp it with--a large nail works well if you don't have a pipe tool.
Fill the pipe with tobacco, pack it down halfway, top it off, pack it down to 3/4, top it off again, pack gently and enjoy. Smoke
slower than you think you need to, the tobacco tastes best when it is burning cool. Tamp and re-light as needed. If you still
have trouble, try different methods on YouTube until you find one that works for you.
>smoking a pipe will give you cancer
Originally the Surgeon General found that pipe and cigar smokers, following a careful study of the statistics (at a time when
most adults smoked, so they had a good sample size), had insignificant death rate increases. Nowadays, tobacco is being
legislated against while hard drugs are being legalized. Put two and two together. Tobacco is just another good thing under attack by the government.

>muh weed
Not the time or place. Start your own thread.

All tobacco users welcome.

item.title: [ 86] /twg/ - Taiwan General
item.description:
Quick Start Guide for First Timers:

Visa: Most countries get 90 days visa-free. Check if you need an eVisa or ARC if staying longer. Fill out your arrival card online before arriving for less stress.
Best Time: Oct–Dec for perfect weather (dry season). Avoid July–Sept typhoon season unless you like rain and chaos.
Getting Around: Taipei MRT is clean, cheap, and efficient as fuck. Youbike only needs an easy card and is essentially free unless you want to ride for hours.
High Speed Rail (HSR) for city hopping (Taipei Kaohsiung in ~1.5h).
Scooters are god outside Taipei. Get an international permit if you plan to ride.
Uber works but taxis are cheap. Avoid during rush hour or rain.

Food:

Night markets are mandatory. Shilin, Raohe, Ningxia, etc.
Must eats: Beef noodle soup, stinky tofu (acquired taste), oyster omelettes, bubble tea (original homeland), pineapple cake, mango shaved ice. All you can eat hotpot also.
7-11 and FamilyMart are better than in most countries, you can live off them if you want.

Top Spots:

Taipei: 101, Jiufen old street, Beitou hot springs, temples everywhere.
Taroko Gorge (east coast) — absolute kino nature.
Sun Moon Lake, Kenting (beaches), Alishan for mountains.
East coast for chill vibes and fewer tourists.

General Tips:

Taiwanese people are polite and helpful. Learn basic Mandarin or use Google Translate.
Tipping is not expected.

Useful Links & Services:

Official Taiwan Tourism: https://eng.taiwan.net.tw/
YouBike: https://en.youbike.com.tw/
EasyCard: Buy at MRT/7-11 — https://www.easycard.com.tw/en/
HSR: https://www.thsrc.com.tw/
Hot Springs: https://taiwanhotspring.net/ + https://eng.taiwan.net.tw/m1.aspx?sNo=0002035

Fill in the countries and subdivisions you have visited, talk about your map and ask others about their maps. You can add or remove colors and change the map as much as you want in any way you want. Don't like this map? Upload a completely different one. Up to you. >look for a cheap place to stay while visa times reset
>insanely cheap from checking out online, lots of places 24/7, train up and down the country, and english spoken
>why the fuck does no one talk about this place? I think I saw some people on trv talk about it once
>book in KL
Holy shit I did not think it possible for something to be less soulless than fucking Seoul. The air sucks, the food portions suck, the weather sucks, the "local transportation" is ass, everyone smells like sewage or curry, you run through things and then it's just "mall mall mall hey did you want to check out that small attraction at the mall?" from anyone you meet. Bars are just awful filled with obvious chinese scammers or old fucks from UK, sometimes passing business people. Try to look online for interesting things, you can blow out KL in like 2.5 weeks of going out, and everyone just says "never run out of things,,," and don't get me started at 5AM singing.

Is there any saving grace for this place?
